metadata.bathymetry_source_version: The GEBCO_2026 Grid is the 2026 release of the  global bathymetric product published by the General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO) and has been developed through the Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project. This is a collaborative project between the Nippon Foundation of Japan and GEBCO. The Seabed 2030 Project aims to bring together all available bathymetric data to produce the definitive map of the world ocean floor and make it available to all.
metadata.bathymetry_license: The GEBCO Grid is placed in the public domain and may be used free of charge. Use of the GEBCO Grid indicates that the user accepts the conditions of use and disclaimer information: https://www.gebco.net/
metadata.vertical_reference_warning: Marine water level and GEBCO elevation use separately documented vertical references. No datum transformation has been applied.
metadata.marine_data_note: Copernicus Marine analysis and forecast fields are gridded model products, not independent in-situ observations.
metadata.sampling_note: Sliding forecast windows overlap and are temporally correlated.
